name: STIHL MS 201 T C-M
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile “Picco” chain, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links, per STIHL’s 2025 and 2017 chain-selection charts.
intro: The MS 201 T C-M is STIHL's top-handle arborist saw, and its chain is STIHL's 3/8″ PICCO (63 PM3) loop, the low-profile family, not the standard 3/8″ chain used on the larger MS 311 or MS 362. STIHL's 2025 selection chart lists 12″, 14″ and 16″ lightweight bars for it, in a block shared with the MS 194 and MS 201 C-EM; the 2017 chart lists the same loops and bars in a block with the MS 192 and MS 193. Each row below restates the chart's drive-link count and chain marketing number.

bars.note: STIHL's 2025 selection chart and the 2017 chart both list chain 63 PM3 44 (3/8″ PICCO) with lightweight bar 3005 000 7405 for the MS 194 / MS 201 group of saws.
STIHL's 2025 selection chart and the 2017 chart both list chain 63 PM3 50 (3/8″ PICCO) with lightweight bar 3005 000 7409 for the MS 194 / MS 201 group of saws.
STIHL's 2025 selection chart and the 2017 chart both list chain 63 PM3 55 (3/8″ PICCO) with lightweight bar 3005 000 7413 for the MS 194 / MS 201 group of saws.
